title: Nuclei Isolation from Frozen Gonad Tissue
author: Maria del Carmen Sancho Serra

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei Isolation Buffer 1 (NIM1)
steps.instruction: Prepare NIM1 (can be filtered and stored at 4°C for up to 6 months).

substeps.instruction: Combine 4.279 g Sucrose (342.3 g/mol), 625 µl 2 mol/l KCl, 250 µl 1 mol/l MgCl2, and 500 µl 1 mol/l Tris buffer (pH8).
Add 48.625 ml nuclease free water to reach a total volume of 50 ml.

steps.title: Prepare Nuclei Isolation Buffer 2 (NIM2)
steps.instruction: Prepare NIM2 on the day of the experiment and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Pre-dilute 1M DTT: mix 5 ml 1 M DTT with 4.995 ml water.
Prepare 100x Protease inhibitor stock: dissolve 1 tablet in 500 ml nuclease free water (store at 2 to 8 °C for 1-2 weeks, or -15 to -25 °C for 12 weeks).
Combine 10 µl DTT pre-made stock (1 mol/l), 100 µl 100x protease inhibitor, and 9.89 ml NIM1 for a total volume of 10 ml.

steps.title: Prepare Homogenization Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare Homogenization Buffer on the day of the experiment and keep on ice; do NOT vortex.

substeps.instruction: Combine 100 µl RNaseIn Plus (40 U/µl), 100 µl Superasin (20 U/µl), 100 µl Triton X-100 (10%), and 9.7 ml NIM2 for a total volume of 10 ml.
Combine 0.1 g BSA (1%), 50 µl RNasin (40 U/µl), and 9.9496 ml 1xPBS for a total volume of 10 ml.

steps.title: Prepare 90% Percoll Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh and keep on ice.

substeps.instruction: Mix 4.5 mL Percoll and 0.5 mL 10x PBS.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Tissue
steps.instruction: Prepare the homogenizer and retrieve the frozen tissue.

substeps.instruction: Clean Dounce homogenizers and pestle B with 70% ethanol, then Milli-Q water.
Pre-chill the homogenizer and a 50 ml Falcon tube on ice.
Collect tissue on dry ice from -80 °C freezer and proceed immediately.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt the tissue to release nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Transfer tissue biopsy to the homogenizer using sterile, disposable tweezers (if in OCT, transfer cut slides directly to the homogenizer on dry ice).
Mix Homogenization buffer and transfer 3 mL to the homogenizer, washing the tissue to the bottom; wait until buffer is liquid again.
Gently homogenize using the tight pestle (B) with 10-20 up-and-down strokes; do not grind and avoid bubbles.
Rinse the pestle with 0.5 mL of Homogenization buffer.
Place the pestle in Virkon for cleaning.

steps.title: Filter and Pelleted Nuclei
steps.instruction: Filter the homogenate and isolate the nuclei via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Pour homogenate through a 40 µm cell strainer into a 50 ml Falcon tube on ice.
Rinse the homogenizer with an additional 0.5 mL Homogenization buffer and pour through the strainer, pipetting filtrate droplets from the underside of the strainer.
Centrifuge the 50 ml Falcon tube at 500 g for 6 mins at 4 °C (acceleration 0, deceleration 3).
Carefully remove most of the supernatant with a 1 ml pipette tip.
Gently resuspend nuclei using a wide bore tip (optional), add 0.5 mL Wash buffer, resuspend, and transfer to a 1.5 ml eppendorf (NOT low bind).

steps.title: Wash and Quality Check
steps.instruction: Wash the nuclei and perform an initial quality check.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 g for 3 mins at 4 °C.
Remove all supernatant and resuspend nuclei in the remaining (~100 µl) wash buffer.
Check nuclei quality using a C-Chip (5 µl filtered Trypan blue, 5 µl nuclei suspension).

steps.title: Prepare Diluted Nuclei Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare this buffer while centrifuging nuclei in the previous step.

substeps.instruction: Combine 25 µl 20x Nuclei buffer, 0.5 µl DTT, 12.5 µl RNase Inh, and 460 µl nuclease free water.

steps.title: Final Nuclei Purification
steps.instruction: Resuspend and filter nuclei, adjusting for debris.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend nuclei in 100 µL of Diluted Nuclei Buffer (if density is sufficient).
Check nuclei in the new buffer using a C-Chip (5 µl filtered Trypan blue, 5 µl nuclei suspension); note that they may appear clumpy.
If there is significant debris, filter with a 40 µm Flowmi cell strainer and check again; otherwise, skip Flowmi filtering.
Count nuclei using a C-Chip (5 µl filtered Trypan blue, 5 µl nuclei suspension).
If necessary, concentrate by centrifuging at 500 g for 3 mins at 4 °C and removing extra supernatant.

steps.title: Optional Percoll Clean-up
steps.instruction: Perform Percoll gradient purification if many debris are present.

substeps.instruction: Prepare two eppendorf tubes with 475 µL Wash Buffer each.
Add 225 µL of the nuclei solution and 300 µL of 90% Percoll solution to each tube.
Mix by inverting the tubes 5 times.
Centrifuge at 20,000 g for 15 min at 4 °C.
Collect the supernatant without touching the floating pellet in the middle-lower part of the tube.
Add 500-900 µl Wash Buffer and centrifuge at 500 g for 3 min at 4 °C.
Collect as much supernatant as possible, add 500 µl Wash Buffer to each tube, and combine into one tube.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 3 min at 4 °C.
Remove most supernatant, leaving 50-100 µl for resuspension.
Count nuclei using a C-Chip (5 µl filtered Trypan blue, 5 µl nuclei suspension).
Concentrate if necessary (500 g, 3 mins, 4 °C).

steps.title: Final Processing
steps.instruction: Finalize the nuclei solution and proceed to downstream applications.

substeps.instruction: If the solution is clean enough (without Percoll), add 0.5 mL more Wash buffer.
Follow 10X Single Cell Multiome ATAC + Gene Expression kit protocol (isothermal incubation, GEM generation/barcoding, GEM incubation, and quenching reaction).
Keep GEMs at -80 °C.
